question: Which country topped the Global Investment Risk and Resilience Index 2025 as the most resilient destination for investors?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Switzerland**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Switzerland emerged as the world’s most resilient country for investors in the Global Investment Risk and Resilience Index 2025 released by Henley & Partners and AlphaGeo.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The Global Investment Risk and Resilience Index 2025** evaluates countries based on investment risk exposure and resilience capacity.
 
• **Switzerland ranked first globally**, supported by very low geopolitical and economic risk and strong innovation capabilities.
 
• **Resilience assessment includes adaptability, recovery capacity, and long-term stability** amid global uncertainties.
 
• **The index reflects how countries manage risks from geopolitics, technology disruption, and climate challenges.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **India ranked 104th**, indicating challenges in investment risk management and resilience capacity.
 
• **Nordic countries** performed strongly due to equitable growth models and progressive social policies.
 
• **Singapore** stood out as Asia’s most resilient economy, backed by a strong legal and regulatory framework.
 
• **Lebanon ranked last**, reflecting deep economic instability and political vulnerability.
